about: jaToRuby(ja, table): the Ruby and the Japanese line of each Ruby line, or the errors (on Japanese lines) when there is no Ruby. The tables are made by each implementation: "none" is no table (names are local variables, no function), "plain" has only 表示する → puts (see README.md).

cases.title: an assignment
an array and its element
a name in capitals is written as it is
the integer quotient
not and or
a counting loop becomes a while loop that adds the step
cases.ja:
i を 3 から 1 まで 1 ずつ減らしながら繰り返す:
⎿ 表示する(i)
cases.ruby:
i = 3
while i >= 1
  puts(i)
  i += -1
end

cases.title: a loop on a `not` is an until loop
cases.ja:
not x の間繰り返す:
  x = 真

cases.title: a function and its parameters
cases.ja:
関数 たす(a, b):
    返す a + b + c

cases.title: a block that ends by its indent puts the blank lines after its end
cases.ja:
もし a > 0 ならば:
    a = 1

b = 2

cases.title: a block closed by a line of its own has its end on that line
cases.ja:
もし a > 0 ならば
  a = 1

を実行する # c
b = 2
cases.ruby:
if a > 0
  a = 1

end # c
b = 2

cases.title: a counting loop closed by `を繰り返す` adds the step on that line
cases.ja:
i を 3 から 1 まで -1 ずつ減らしながら
  表示する(i)
を繰り返す
cases.ruby:
i = 3
while i >= 1
  puts(i)
  i += -(-1)
end

cases.title: a counting loop closed by another closing word adds the step too
cases.ja:
i を 1 から 3 まで 1 ずつ増やしながら
  表示する(i)
を実行する
cases.ruby:
i = 1
while i <= 3
  puts(i)
  i += 1
end

cases.title: the names and functions are what the table says
a function not in the table is an error

errors.message: 「要素数」は定義されていない関数です
errors.name: 要素数

cases.title: without a table of inputs, an input is an error
a command of a Ruby system is an error

errors.message: 「move」は日本語モードでは書けない命令です
errors.name: move

cases.title: the settings: indexes from 1
cases.ja:
# すべての配列の添字は 1 から始まる。
A[i] = A[i + 1]
cases.ruby:
# すべての配列の添字は 1 から始まる。
A[i - 1] = A[i]

cases.title: a name with 々, 〆, ヶ, a kanji of the CJK extensions or one out of the BMP is one name (Issue #1714)
cases.ja:
佐々木 = 7
x〆 = 佐々木 + 2
㐀ヶ = 1
𠮷田 = 1
表示する(佐々木)
cases.ruby:
佐々木 = 7
x〆 = 佐々木 + 2
㐀ヶ = 1
𠮷田 = 1
puts(佐々木)

cases.title: a Greek or full-width letter is a name, of its own (ｘ is not x), and full-width digits are in a name after its first character
a combining mark is in a name (か and ゙)
a character that is not a letter is not read, and one out of the BMP is told whole
a multiple assignment to elements of an array (the swap) writes them as elements (Issue #2237)
full-width digits are read as the digits (only how they look differs), and the Ruby has the half-width ones
a name right after a number is not read as a product: the error says to write an operator

errors.message: 「2倍」は読めません。数と名前の間には、「2 * 倍」のように演算子を書いてください

cases.title: a name right after full-width digits is told the same way

errors.message: 「１０回」は読めません。数と名前の間には、「１０ * 回」のように演算子を書いてください

cases.title: the box-drawing marks │ and └ are read as ｜ and ⎿ (only how they look differs), with | too
cases.ja:
もし x > 0 ならば:
│ もし y > 0 ならば:
│ └ y = 1
└ z = 2
w = 3
cases.ruby:
if x > 0
  if y > 0
    y = 1
  end
  z = 2
end
w = 3

cases.title: | and └ mixed
a full-width # starts a comment, and “…” is a string
cases.ja: 表示する(“やあ”)  ＃ あいさつ
